goal: Serialize streaming conversation switch, create and delete actions so active generation is stopped, partial output is persisted as interrupted, and the target action occurs exactly once.
non_goals: Do not build the Task 12 transcript HUD or Task 13 voice/TTS state machine.
Do not change canvas geometry, rich media, retrieval, AI permissions, credentials, recovery or release behavior.
Do not alter remote sync formats beyond preserving Task 10 completionState behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Switch, new, temporary and delete-current actions serialize abort request, stream close, interrupted persistence and target action in that order.
Deleting a non-active conversation does not cancel the active stream.
Abort or persistence failure keeps the current conversation, received text and active target IDs without creating or deleting another conversation.
Repeated UI actions do not create duplicate conversations, orphan messages or overlapping transactions.
History actions expose explicit stop-and-switch or stop-and-delete confirmation while streaming.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed and independently reviewed.
do_not_touch: remote repositories before the Phase C push gate
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep review/report evidence concise.
Preserve partial assistant output and Task 10 source canvas context.
Use one serialized promise chain and fail closed before the target action.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Never inspect, print, log or modify configured provider secrets.
